observations.trace: Current evaluation selects typed posture/action samples and propagates checked errors before constructing AnimationEvaluation. Current dive and airborne blends use typed clamped inverse lerps; current locomotion computes a run blend from independently acquired walk and run profiles using NonnegativeSpeed::clamped_inverse_lerp. This rejects non-increasing bounds. Each complete AnimationLocomotionConfig checks run reference speed strictly exceeds walk and blend speed exceeds the initial speed.
observations.remaining: No assertion of bitwise equivalence with6533 raw floating arithmetic, all SkeletonState inputs or authored clips is made. Attack animation absence/default policy and native pose/curve semantics remain separately open.

observations.trace: The runtime snapshot is process-global and copied behind a RwLock with versioned thread-local caches. The walk and run helpers separately read it, and gait_profile also obtains landing tuning independently. A single validated snapshot guarantees run>walk; as a symbolic conditional example only, if reads could span two valid snapshots with (walk,run)=(5,6) then (1,2), the mixed lower5/upper2 would fail the checked inverse lerp. The semantic-route source warns and removes its trace when evaluation returns an error.
observations.safeguard: The client observer validates and installs a received config; server join and reconnect send one. Pinned Bevy Replicon source queues a trigger, Bevy Commands queues the world trigger, and the Bevy multi-thread executor applies deferred commands with exclusive access or after systems complete. This is evidence against assuming the ordinary same-world observer interleaves with that evaluation; it does not prove every process-wide installation, multiple-world setup, public caller, or scheduler lifecycle is serialized. No concurrent run or actual mixed snapshot was observed.
observations.remaining: Identify all supported installers and process/world lifetimes, establish whether any read can span versions, and decide whether shared-core rule applies. Preserve startup and legitimate config changes. This is connected to existing059 queue1550/1624, not counted as an independent new finding.

observations.trace: CoalescedEventBudget accepts a nonzero u64 and its contains compares a full-width span. The current contact presenter first checks the observed non-wrapping delta against the configured budget and then iterates/reverses the offsets and collects a vector; landing presentation emits only the latest in-budget event. The shown playback validation adds no upper bound for this budget; committed YAML sets8. The authoritative contact-identity helper has a separate handoff loop.
observations.safeguard: This is a configured bound on presentation event count, not proof of an arbitrary unbounded production delta, configuration reachability, allocation failure, denial of service, or an actual dropped event. Producers, observation gaps and independent core handoff work need separate tracing. Non-wrapping/reset policy and native audio/capture behavior remain open.
